verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud exposes a REST API for managing agents, secrets, builds and sessions, so bulk operations are a fair question for this product, but no evidence documents batch or bulk endpoints or multi-item actions. Multi-agent parallel fan-out and unlimited session concurrency are adjacent runtime capabilities, not user-facing bulk operations across items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
